ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising edge used to capture key_mem and xtea fields in the two clocked processes; it sequences all clocked updates for CSR writes and the XTEA core.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in csr_write_access and xtea_core processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Active-low reset overrides and initializes key_mem and all xtea fields to zero in both clocked processes; it forces the recovery values on reset.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... end if in csr_write_access and xtea_core processes

ports.name: start_i
ports.functionality: Acts as a start request that, when asserted with the right rtype, gates capture of rs1/rs2 into xtea.opa/opb and sets xtea.done(0) to begin an operation.
ports.evidence: if (start_i = '1') and (rtype_i = r3type_c) then xtea.opa<=rs1_i; xtea.opb<=rs2_i; xtea.done(0)<= '1' in xtea_core

ports.name: active_i
ports.functionality: Declared input that is not read or used anywhere in this source; it has no effect inside this entity.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of active_i in the source

ports.name: csr_we_i
ports.functionality: Gates writes into the key_mem array when asserted; used only in the CSR write process to qualify storing csr_wdata_i at csr_addr_i.
ports.evidence: if (csr_we_i = '1') then key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) <= csr_wdata_i in csr_write_access

ports.name: csr_addr_i
ports.functionality: Selects which key_mem element is read or written; it is used as the index for key_mem in both the CSR write process and the csr_rdata_o read assignment.
ports.evidence: key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i))) in csr_write_access and csr_rdata_o <= key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(csr_addr_i)))

ports.name: csr_wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the 32-bit data written into the key_mem entry when csr_we_i is asserted; it is captured into key_mem on the clock edge.

ports.name: csr_rdata_o
ports.functionality: Exports the addressed key_mem entry to the entity boundary by carrying the selected key_mem element to the output port.

ports.name: rtype_i
ports.functionality: Controls which operation path is taken: it gates capture/start of the XTEA operation in the core and also gates the result_select process to enable result_o/valid_o when rtype matches r3type_c.
ports.evidence: used in if (start_i = '1') and (rtype_i = r3type_c) in xtea_core and if (rtype_i = r3type_c) in result_select

ports.name: funct3_i
ports.functionality: Both gates internal xtea updates (sum/res computations) and selects among combinational alternatives: it controls xtea.sum and xtea.res branches, selects operands for tmp_* signals, and serves as the case selector that chooses result_o/valid_o branches.
ports.evidence: conditions in xtea_core (funct3_i(...) = ...) and tmp_* when ... else assignments and case funct3_i in result_select

ports.name: funct7_i
ports.functionality: Declared but not referenced anywhere in this source; it does not affect behavior in this entity.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of funct7_i in the source

ports.name: rs1_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the 32-bit operand captured into xtea.opa on start; it is a source for the XTEA operand register.
ports.evidence: xtea.opa <= rs1_i inside xtea_core when start condition

ports.name: rs2_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the 32-bit operand captured into xtea.opb on start; it is a source for the XTEA operand register.
ports.evidence: xtea.opb <= rs2_i inside xtea_core when start condition

ports.name: rs3_i
ports.functionality: Declared operand input that is not read or used in this source; it has no effect inside this entity.
ports.evidence: no occurrences of rs3_i in the source

ports.name: result_o
ports.functionality: Drives the external result port by carrying the xtea.res register value (or constants for init/others); it presents the computed result to the entity boundary.
ports.evidence: result_o <= xtea.res and other branches in result_select process

ports.name: valid_o
ports.functionality: Exports the result valid flag driven from xtea.done(1) or constants; it reports when result_o holds a valid operation result.
ports.evidence: valid_o <= xtea.done(1) in result_select for certain funct3 cases

signals.name: key_mem
signals.functionality: Stores four 32-bit key words written from csr_wdata_i at positions selected by csr_addr_i on csr_we_i; supplies selected key words to csr_rdata_o and tmp_z.
role: supplies key words to tmp_z and csr_rdata_o
signals.evidence: key_mem <= ... in csr_write_access; csr_rdata_o <= key_mem(...); tmp_z <= key_mem(...) concurrent

signals.name: xtea
signals.function: aggregate register of XTEA core fields
signals.functionality: Groups the XTEA internal fields (done, opa, opb, sum, res) which are reset and updated on clock edges; represents the core operation state.
signals.evidence: type xtea_t record and assignments xtea.done<=..., xtea.opa<=..., etc in xtea_core reset and clock branches

signals.name: xtea.done
signals.functionality: Bit0 is set on a start condition and bit1 follows bit0 on the next clock; bit1 is used as the external valid flag for results.
signals.evidence: xtea.done(0)<= '0'; xtea.done(1)<= xtea.done(0); xtea.done(0)<= '1' in xtea_core; valid_o <= xtea.done(1) in result_select

signals.name: xtea.opa
signals.functionality: Captures rs1_i into the opa field on a start condition and supplies opa to combinational tmp signals and to the sum computation when selected.
signals.evidence: xtea.opa <= rs1_i on start in xtea_core; tmp_* assignments read xtea.opa; xtea.sum <= xtea.opa in xtea_core (funct3 branch)

signals.name: xtea.opb
signals.functionality: Captures rs2_i into the opb field on a start condition and supplies opb to combinational tmp signals used in the round computation.
signals.evidence: xtea.opb <= rs2_i on start in xtea_core; tmp_* assignments read xtea.opb

signals.name: xtea.sum
signals.functionality: Is updated from opa or incremented/decremented by the delta according to funct3_i, and its low bits (and other slices) select key_mem entries and enter tmp_r arithmetic.
signals.evidence: xtea.sum <= xtea.opa or xtea.sum +/- xtea_delta_c in xtea_core; tmp_z uses xtea.sum(...); tmp_r expression uses xtea.sum

signals.name: xtea.res
signals.functionality: Captures the round result computed from tmp_b and tmp_r (sum or difference) when xtea.done(0) is set, and supplies that held result to the result_o output.
signals.evidence: xtea.res <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(tmp_b) +/- unsigned(tmp_r)) in xtea_core; result_o <= xtea.res in result_select

signals.name: tmp_a
signals.functionality: Combinationally forwards either xtea.opb or xtea.opa depending on funct3_i(0); its value is used in the tmp_r arithmetic and later captured into xtea.res indirectly.
signals.evidence: tmp_a <= xtea.opb when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opa concurrent

signals.name: tmp_b
signals.functionality: Combinationally forwards either xtea.opa or xtea.opb depending on funct3_i(0); it is used directly in the xtea.res capture as the add/sub operand.
signals.evidence: tmp_b <= xtea.opa when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opb concurrent

signals.name: tmp_x
signals.functionality: Constructs a 32-bit value by concatenating xtea.opb(27 downto 0) or xtea.opa(27 downto 0) with "0000" depending on funct3_i(0); used in the tmp_r arithmetic.
signals.evidence: tmp_x <= xtea.opb(27 downto 0) & "0000" when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else xtea.opa(27 downto 0) & "0000"

signals.name: tmp_y
signals.functionality: Constructs a 32-bit value by concatenating "00000" with xtea.opb(31 downto 5) or xtea.opa(31 downto 5) depending on funct3_i(0); it participates in the tmp_r arithmetic.
signals.evidence: tmp_y <= "00000" & xtea.opb(31 downto 5) when (funct3_i(0) = '0') else "00000" & xtea.opa(31 downto 5)

signals.name: tmp_z
signals.functionality: Derives its value from key_mem selected by slices of xtea.sum (two different slice ranges depending on funct3_i(0)); its value enters tmp_r computation.
signals.evidence: tmp_z <= key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(xtea.sum(1 downto 0)))) when ... else key_mem(to_integer(unsigned(xtea.sum(12 downto 11))))

signals.name: tmp_r
signals.functionality: Computes the combined arithmetic expression (xor/add/xor) from tmp_x,tmp_y,tmp_a,xtea.sum and tmp_z; its result is used to form xtea.res on the next clock.
signals.evidence: tmp_r <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(tmp_x xor tmp_y) + unsigned(tmp_a)) xor std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(xtea.sum) + unsigned(tmp_z)) concurrent
